name: Wikipedia · Grace Hopper
description: Start in a blank Chrome tab, open Wikipedia, find Grace Hopper, scroll through the article and close the tab.
intro: Welcome. We will take a short tour of Grace Hopper's Wikipedia article.

steps.title: Open Wikipedia
steps.say: In the blank Chrome tab I type Wikipedia's address and press Return.

steps.title: Search for Grace Hopper
steps.say: I type Grace Hopper in Wikipedia's search field.

steps.title: Open the Grace Hopper article
steps.say: I click the matching search result.

steps.title: Scroll through the article
steps.say: I scroll down to read more of the article.

steps.title: Click the tab's close button
steps.say: I move the pointer to the tab's close button and click it.
